geometry_strategy: Approved Rev29 drawer fit, body, front field, and number standard preserved. Each peppermint knob uses one continuous closed cap with eight Candy Red and eight White curved sectors sharing a flush, gap-free outer surface. The pattern reaches the perimeter and wraps over the rounded side to the lower rim. The cap overlaps the approved knob throughout so no color geometry floats. The original frame is replaced by two clean non-touching Gold bead rows. Candy canes are continuous swept manifold tubes with face-assigned stripes. Open number boundaries are capped. All reopened 3MF files must have zero open and non-manifold edges.

color_mapping.name: White Silk PLA
color_mapping.role: peppermint sectors, candy-cane stripes, snowflakes, and angels

color_mapping.name: Candy Red Silk PLA
color_mapping.role: raised numbers, hearts, and peppermint/candy-cane sectors

color_mapping.name: Gold Silk PLA
color_mapping.role: double-beaded frame, stars, angel halos, and tree peak balls

number_standard.rule: same height, depth, vertical center, and horizontal group center as drawer 1; two-digit numbers remain centered as a pair

material_order_note: All 24 files include the same five materials in the same order for consistent slicer/AMS assignment.
